406. Range Updates and Queries

Problem Statement:
The question is simple.

You are given an array X of N numbers. We have Q queries which can be either of the following forms:

1 x y S : increase numbers from X[x]. X[x+1] ...X[y] by S

2 x y : Find the maximum of numbers from X[x] . X[x+1] . X[x+2]....X[y]

Perform the above operations and report the answer
input_spec:
First line contains an single integer N denoting the number of integers in X
Second line contains N integers the contents of X
The next line contains a single integer Q : the number of queries
The next Q lines contains either:
1 x y S (or) 2 x y
output_spec: For each query of type 2 output the maximum in a single line
